scope: The complete local scripted Castaway freshwater journey, three discriminating negative action paths, retained causal trace, and exact replay at the observed World Substrate revision.

test_selection.changed_boundary: One neutral submission, transition, process, evidence, and replay path now owns the complete freshwater scenario rather than donor-private execution.
test_selection.failure_hypothesis: The neutral runtime could appear green while diverging from a donor checkpoint, losing liquid or vessel identity, mutating state on rejection, conflating invalid and unsupported actions, or failing exact replay.
test_selection.discriminating_probe: Execute the 22-command fill-through-give journey against the pinned fixture, compare semantic checkpoint and ledger fields, then execute overfill, valid unsupported pressure, and malformed fill envelopes and replay all paths.
test_selection.decision_if_pass: Promote M1 and make M2 policy-consumer authorization the next planning boundary.
test_selection.decision_if_fail: Keep M1 active and repair the first divergent transition, evidence surface, or replay path before policy integration.

journey.starting_state: Two colocated living actors, one clay pot, one metal cup, a finite pathogen-bearing freshwater source, a finite-fuel fire, explicit carrying state, and registered neutral rules/processes.
journey.input: The scripted controller selects discovered fill, heat, unheat, pour, drink, take, and give actions while the runner advances fifteen deterministic ticks; separate engines receive the three negative envelopes.
steps: Verify the committed transfer trace still matches the executable positive probe.
Compare final tick, actors, vessels, physical ledger, fuel, and vessel identity with the pinned donor checkpoint.
Replay all 22 positive commands and require identical material hash and events.
Submit an overfill and require atomic precondition_failed with exact replay.
Submit a valid unregistered pressure envelope and require atomic unsupported_action with exact replay.
Submit a malformed registered fill envelope and require atomic invalid_action with exact replay.
Run the self-contained project gate, 24 tests, Ruff, and mypy at the same revision.

surface_observations.observation: The executable reported that both retained M1 evidence artifacts match the bounded probe.
The positive semantic checkpoint and ledger matched, all three negative statuses were distinct and atomic, and every replay was exact.
The retained 22-command trace reproduced the same material hash and complete event sequence.
The comparison used the committed fixture derived from Castaway revision da5ccb46fa536505bbc0235a4157c648c8bb4bcb.
The compact human review exposes the final state, conservation/treatment results, identity result, replay result, and all negative outcomes.

outcome.observed_result: The complete M1 scripted journey and all three discriminating negatives passed at revision 55725233f65af625edfc0a09067de3aa97d34efe.
outcome.state_change: The clay pot ended at tick 15 owned by Friday with 728 ml of pathogen-free water; the ledger accounted for treatment, evaporation, drinking, heat, and exact replay, while rejected envelopes made no material change.

limitations: The controller is scripted and this receipt makes no LLM-policy competence claim.
The donor comparison is semantic rather than raw-hash equality because the state and event schemas intentionally differ.
One physical reference vertical does not establish cross-domain reuse, scale, deployment, or real-world physical calibration.
The maturity observation is local and causes no model call or external side effect.
